pitch:
ShapeKraft Quote-First Desk (all prices in Indian rupees, plus 18% GST)

- What it does: when a buyer sends an enquiry (on IndiaMART, WhatsApp, email or your website), a quote is drafted from your own price list and sent to you on WhatsApp within minutes. You check it and send it in one tap. Nothing goes out without your approval. You update today's rates by sending a WhatsApp message, and you can set special prices for your top customers.
- Start with a 14-day pilot for Rs 5,000: we load your real Excel price list and connect your real enquiries. If fewer than 7 in 10 drafted quotes go out without you changing the price, you get the Rs 5,000 back.
- If the pilot works, the full desk with a fast catalogue website is Rs 60,000 setup plus Rs 5,000 a month (hosting, keeping the desk running, rate updates, 2 hours of changes). The pilot fee is deducted from the setup. Pay 40% to start, 30% at build, 30% at launch.
- After launch, if the desk stops drafting at least 8 in 10 quotes without price changes, you pay no monthly fee until it does.
- In writing: you own the domain, the website code, the hosting account and your price-list data. If ShapeKraft ever stops, everything is handed over to you.
- Proof: you can see a quote drafted from your own price list before paying anything more than the pilot, and ask for a reference call with the chemical-trading company whose website and enquiry forms ShapeKraft built in 2026 (if they agree).
- Founding offer: the first 5 distributors who continue after the pilot pay Rs 45,000 setup instead of Rs 60,000, in exchange for a short published case study. Ends 31 January 2027.
